prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures the bustling interior of a fire station garage. On the far left, a tall firefighter in a yellow helmet stands upright, holding a coiled hose. Next to him, a small dalmatian puppy sits attentively, looking up at the firefighter's boots. In the center foreground, a mechanic in blue overalls kneels beside a large red fire truck, tightening a bolt on the front wheel. A silver wrench lies on the concrete floor near the mechanic's knee. Behind the truck, a captain in a white shirt points toward an open locker door. Inside that locker, a folded orange jacket is visible. To the right of the captain, a young cadet in a grey uniform leans against the wall, checking a wristwatch. Above them, a hanging fluorescent light fixture emits a soft glow. Near the right edge, a woman in a green coat hands a paper cup to a seated man in a brown sweater. The man in the brown sweater sits on a wooden bench, smiling as he accepts the drink. Beside the bench, a black backpack rests on the floor. In the background, two firefighters in full gear walk through an open bay door, their helmets reflecting the daylight. One of these background firefighters carries a heavy axe over his shoulder. Near the entrance, a bulletin board displays various notices, pinned with colorful tacks. A clock on the wall above the board shows the time clearly. On the far right, a cat with striped fur sleeps atop a stack of tires. Next to the tires, a mop bucket stands ready for use. In the upper corner, a ceiling fan hangs motionless. There is no smoke in the air. There is no fire visible anywhere. There is no text written on the walls.
